import numpy as np, math
from PIL import Image
im=np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0118.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
cx,cy,h=0.649,1.051,-30.0   # DR pose (landmark-validated)
hr=math.radians(h); F=(math.sin(hr),math.cos(hr)); Rt=(math.cos(hr),-math.sin(hr))
def bp(u,v,z=0.0):
    D=(1.55-z)*256./(v-256.); L=D*(u-256)/256.
    return round(cx+D*F[0]+L*Rt[0],3), round(cy+D*F[1]+L*Rt[1],3), round(D,2)
brown=(R<175)&((R-B)>22)&(G<R-12)&(G>B-6)
def groups(mask,u0,u1,minrun=2):
    ys,xs=np.nonzero(mask[:,u0:u1])
    if len(xs)==0: return []
    cols=sorted(set(xs+u0)); gs=[];cur=[cols[0]]
    for u in cols[1:]:
        if u-cur[-1]<=3: cur.append(u)
        else: gs.append(cur);cur=[u]
    gs.append(cur)
    return [g for g in gs if len(g)>=minrun]
print('=== CHAIR u90-200 (brown incl dark legs)')
ys,xs=np.nonzero(brown[:,90:200]); print(' n',len(xs),'u',xs.min()+90,xs.max()+90,'v',ys.min(),ys.max())
for u in range(100,185,4):
    c=np.nonzero(brown[:,u])[0]
    if len(c)>2:
        b=c.max(); g=bp(u,b)
        print('  u',u,'top',c.min(),'bot',b,'gnd',g,'topz',round(1.55-g[2]*(c.min()-256)/256.,2))
print('=== STOOL u280-340')
for u in range(284,326,4):
    c=np.nonzero(brown[:,u])[0]
    if len(c)>2: print('  u',u,'top',c.min(),'bot',c.max(),'gnd',bp(u,c.max()))
print('=== PLANT POT u455-511')
for u in range(458,510,6):
    c=np.nonzero(brown[:,u])[0]
    if len(c)>2: print('  u',u,'top',c.min(),'bot',c.max(),'gnd',bp(u,c.max()))
grn=(G>R+30)&(G>B+30)
ys,xs=np.nonzero(grn); print('=== GREEN n',len(xs),'u',xs.min(),xs.max(),'v',ys.min(),ys.max())
print('=== LAMP grayblue u225-265')
gb=(abs(R-G)<12)&(B>R+8)&(R>60)&(R<130)
for u in range(228,262,4):
    c=np.nonzero(gb[:,u])[0]
    if len(c)>2: print('  u',u,'top',c.min(),'bot',c.max(),'gnd',bp(u,c.max()))
EOF
